items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: That was before let’s say Lionel Hampton played the Paramount.

ctx.x: Yeah. That was before let’s say Lionel Hampton played the Paramount. I think that’s where the breakthrough was. But in those days you had all kinds of black and tan clubs and every little club had a band and a singer and a shake dancer and a master of ceremonies. There were maybe four or five within a two block span you know? There was a lot of music going on there, and that was in the late 30s and early 40s.
What brought you to the saxophone?
